futureDirection: For subsequent new characters combine occupation/personality with a researched tale, myth, fable or similar narrative; preserve manga style. This batch preserves established identities.

characters.name: Iara
characters.prompt:
Create ONE INDIVIDUAL CHARACTER MODEL SHEET for Soulmonsters. REFERENCE1 (Kael) is the EXACT art-style and layout authority explicitly chosen by the creator. REFERENCE2 (the five-character lineup) supplies ONLY the identity, skin, body build, hairstyle, clothing colors and equipment of the named character, NOT its more rounded/cartoon drawing style. Redraw in reference1's cleaner 2D MANGA style: delicate uniform thin graphite-dark lines, narrow subtle jaw and chin, oval anime irises with simple highlights, small nose/mouth, elegantly constructed eyes and eyelids, understated expressions. Hair in simple graphic masses. Flat muted local colors with a SINGLE economical crisp cel shadow per surface. No gradients, painted shading, glowing rim, texture, rosy rounded cartoon cheeks, bulbous nose, Disney/Pixar faces, caricature or 3D rendering. Preserve body diversity, age and skin; a robust adult must stay robust and adult, not slimmed or made childlike. Do not give this person Kael's hair or outfit.
White landscape sheet in the SAME FORMAT as Kael: left full-body front three-quarter neutral relaxed pose; center-left full-body back view in matching scale, feet aligned and completely visible; right three separated head-and-shoulder expressions (pleasant, determined, surprised); lower right one small clean uncolored line-art head study. All drawings depict the SAME named person with consistent costume, skin, hair side, eye color and equipment attachment. Small handwritten name top left only. Plenty of whitespace, no overlap, no scenery, no watermark, no large shadows under feet. Front and back actually show opposite sides of the same clothes, no mirrored accessories. Functional props must be human-scale with plausible grip/straps.
Character: IARA, the LEFTMOST person in reference2, 17-year-old athletic dark-brown-skinned girl, brown eyes. Preserve black hair swept back into a thick braided side ponytail whose end is tied into a distinctive small OPEN LOOP, naturally hanging by her anatomical LEFT shoulder/back; reduce gravity-defying curl and giant bead-like cartoon braid. Natural normal-sized head and manga face, quietly assured expression, slim athletic long limbs, no glamour posing. Sage cropped soft round-shoulder jacket with a few broad leaf-fold panels on shoulders, cream collared shirt, charcoal fitted shorts and two practical simple thigh straps, sage high-top climbing shoes with normal small soles. One WOODEN KITE LINE REEL at anatomical LEFT hip on attached belt, plausible axle, looped line. Both views maintain the same left-side braid and left-hip reel; back view shows attachment. Keep distinctive short jacket and identity. Front relaxed braced standing pose with one hand near belt, other resting at side, not pulling string across the sheet. Name "Iara".
